description: This file defines the 'OrderProductAttribute' class, representing attributes associated with an order's product in the sales management system. It includes fields for attribute price, weight, whether it is free, and references to related order and product option entities.

classes.name: OrderProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity class modeling the attributes of an ordered product, including pricing, weight, and associations to related order and product option entities.

methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attribute.
